name.description: Your full name. Shown as the big heading, in the footer and in the page title.

firstName.description: What visitors call you, e.g. in "Contact Jane about this role". Default: the first word of name.

initials.description: 1–3 letters for the round avatar in the AI panel, e.g. "JS".

email.description: Contact email. Shown on the page and given out by the AI when it can't answer.

linkedin.description: Your LinkedIn profile address. Leave out to hide the LinkedIn button.

github.description: Your GitHub profile address. Leave out to hide the GitHub button.

siteUrl.description: The site's public address, e.g. https://personal-ai-resume.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev. Used for link previews.

languages.description: Languages of the site. ["en", "sv"] needs both en.json and sv.json and shows the EN | SE switch. ["en"] hides the switch.

defaultLanguage.description: The language at the site's main address (/). The other language gets its own address, e.g. /sv/.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Public Turnstile site key (docs/SETUP.md step E). Leave out until then; local testing uses Cloudflare's test key.

aiProvider.description: Who generates the AI answers, as named on the privacy page. Must match AI_API_URL in wrangler.jsonc. Default: Groq (USA).

name.description: The company that writes the AI answers, e.g. "Groq".

country.description: Where that company is based, e.g. "USA". Shown in brackets after the name.

logRegion.description: Where your live visitor log database is, as named on the privacy page, e.g. "EU" or "USA". Default: "EU". npm run deploy refuses to publish "EU" unless the database really is restricted to the EU.

title: site.json: settings that are the same in every language
